title: Tesla and SpaceX Explore Merger as Elon Musk Backs Deal
hook_text: Elon Musk Backs Tesla SpaceX Merger
script:
Tesla and SpaceX are exploring a potential merger supported by Elon Musk.
Analytics India Magazine reported on the discussions between the two companies.
Tesla brings its electric vehicle operations and autonomous driving research to the table.
SpaceX contributes its aerospace engineering and Starlink satellite internet network.
Corporate advisors are examining how the integration would handle joint projects.
Would you buy shares in Tesla and SpaceX?
